general.notes: Optical parameters defined at BER 5×10⁻⁵ for 25G Ethernet; FEC required on host equipment. Transmitter output power min/max and receiver min input power, overload per footnotes 1) average power 2) at 25.78Gbps (25GE) and BER 5E-5. Output power OMA min 0 dBm max 6.0 dBm; minimum input power OMA -19.0 dBm. Power budget stated as 10–19 dB (TECHNICAL DATA); ordering description lists 18 dB. Dispersion penalty < 2.7 dB (no paired penalized parameter and operating condition for penalty objects). Transmission media listed as SM (2x LC). I-temp variant referenced as _SO-SFP28-ER-I_ (0 to +85°C), not this part.
general.suggestions: Consider fields for power_budget_db, dispersion_penalty_db_max, tx_oma_min/max_dbm, and storage_temperature_range; distinguish average vs OMA for tx/rx power.
